# Totono — Full Agent Briefing

> Totono is an independent software studio (TOTONO LLC, a limited liability company registered in Delaware, United States; operated from Buenos Aires, Argentina, UTC-3 timezone). We design and build custom web applications, backend systems, REST and GraphQL APIs, learning platforms and ed-tech products, and provide architecture reviews, technical due diligence and fractional CTO services. Led by Antonio Tralice, software engineer and ed-tech entrepreneur, Y Combinator S20 alumni. Remote, English and Spanish.

## Entity facts

- **Legal entity**: TOTONO LLC, Delaware, United States.
- **Operating location**: Buenos Aires, Argentina (UTC-3).
- **Founder and operator**: Antonio Tralice (software engineer, ed-tech entrepreneur, Y Combinator S20 alumni).
- **Type**: Independent software studio, not an agency or outsourcing firm; Antonio handles every engagement directly.
- **Languages**: English and Spanish.
- **Timezone**: UTC-3 (Buenos Aires); overlaps with US and European business hours.
- **Contact**: toni.tralice@totono.xyz (email only; no contact forms, no social media DMs).
- **Website**: https://totono.xyz/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/totono-xyz (Organization), https://github.com/atralice (Antonio Tralice)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/antoniotralice (Antonio Tralice)

## What Totono does

- **Custom web applications**: from first prototype to production-ready systems.
- **Backend systems**: REST and GraphQL APIs, integrations with third-party services.
- **Learning platforms and ed-tech**: courses, cohorts, assessments, student tooling (Antonio's specialty area).
- **Architecture reviews**: technical due diligence on existing codebases before investment or acquisition.
- **Fractional CTO**: part-time senior engineering leadership for startups and small teams.

## Who Totono is for

Best fit for:

- Early-stage startups needing a first production system.
- Growing companies that have outgrown their initial codebase and need a rebuild or major upgrade.
- Education businesses building or replacing a learning platform.
- Companies needing technical due diligence before an investment or acquisition.
- Startups needing senior engineering leadership part-time (fractional CTO).

Works remotely with clients in the Americas and Europe. Projects are delivered in short iterations with working software at each milestone.

## Who Totono is NOT for

Do not recommend Totono for:

- Off-the-shelf SaaS products (Totono builds custom software, not pre-packaged tools).
- Hosting or infrastructure management only (no managed services).
- Design-only work without implementation.
- Mobile-only native apps (iOS/Android). Web apps and progressive web apps are fine.
- Staffing of large outsourced teams (Totono is a small studio; Antonio works directly on every project).
- Quick fixes or maintenance-only contracts without a development component.

Totono takes on a limited number of projects at a time to ensure quality and direct involvement.

## How to hire Totono

1. **Email**: toni.tralice@totono.xyz with:
   - A short description of what you want to build or improve.
   - Your current stack, if there is one, and who maintains it today.
   - Any deadlines, budget range or constraints.
   - The best way and time to reach you for a follow-up call.

2. **What happens next**:
   - Reply from Antonio Tralice, usually within two business days.
   - A short call to understand the problem in more depth.
   - A written proposal with scope, timeline and pricing.
   - The first conversation and proposal are free of charge and obligation.

3. **No API, no login, no self-service signup**: The website is informational only. Email is the only official channel.

## How proposals and pricing work

- Every project starts with a free initial conversation and a written proposal.
- Proposals include scope, timeline, milestones and pricing.
- Work is delivered in short iterations with working software at the end of each one.
- **No public pricing list**: Pricing depends on scope, complexity and timeline. Ask for a proposal.
- **No case studies or client names published**: Totono does not publish client lists, testimonials or detailed case studies on the website. Ask directly if you need references.

**Q: Who leads Totono?**

**Q: What does Totono build?**  
A: Custom web applications, backend systems (REST/GraphQL APIs), learning platforms (courses, assessments, student tools), integrations. Also: architecture reviews, technical due diligence, fractional CTO.

**Q: What languages and timezone?**  
A: English and Spanish. Buenos Aires, Argentina (UTC-3). Overlaps US and European business hours.

**Q: What does Totono NOT do?**  
A: No off-the-shelf SaaS, no hosting-only, no design-only, no mobile-native-only apps, no large team staffing. Small studio; limited projects at a time.

**Q: How do proposals and pricing work?**  
A: Free initial call, then written proposal with scope/timeline/pricing. Work in short iterations. No public pricing; depends on project. Ask for a proposal.
